column1: # Source: MBMA_8803 | Golovin
# Tag: MBMA_8803_TABLES1_STRENGTHSUMMARY

# Content: Measured failure load of the single full-scale three-span continuous Z-purlin roof assembly (MBMA Uplift Test #B-1) tested under uplift pressure with discrete angle braces at the quarter points of the end-bay bottom (compression) flanges.

# Data basis: measured: failure pressure of 2.7 in. H2O converted by the report to a uniform uplift line load (dead load deducted); purlin geometry and yield stress from coupon tests; predicted loads and ratios computed by the report
# Units: see column headers
# Column definitions:
#   test_id = designation of the full-scale test as printed
#   load_direction = direction of applied load (uplift or gravity)
#   section_type = purlin cross-section shape as printed (Z or C)
#   depth_in = nominal purlin depth
#   thickness_in = measured base steel thickness of the failed member
#   span_ft = individual span length
#   n_spans = number of continuous spans in the test setup
#   n_purlin_lines = number of parallel purlin lines tested
#   panel_type = roof panel/sheeting description and attachment type
#   bracing = compression (bottom) flange bracing provided
#   failure_load_as_printed = measured failure load exactly as printed
#   failure_load_unit = unit of the failure load exactly as printed
#   failure_moment_as_printed = measured failure moment exactly as printed (blank if not stated)
#   failure_moment_unit = unit of the failure moment as printed
#   failure_mode = observed mode and location that terminated the test
#   value_source = where in the report the failure value is stated
#   pages = PDF page number(s) where the value is stated
#   lap_length_ft_in = length of purlin lap at interior supports as printed
#   initial_sweep_in = initial lateral sweep of the purlins before loading
#   fy_ksi = yield stress of the failed member used in evaluation
#   se_in3 = effective section modulus used in evaluation
#   predicted_load_aisi6_lb_per_ft = predicted failure load by the modified AISI (AISI-6) method
#   ratio_test_to_aisi6 = test failure load divided by AISI-6 predicted load
#   predicted_load_mbma_lb_per_ft = predicted failure load by the MBMA Ad Hoc Task Force method
#   ratio_test_to_mbma = test failure load divided by MBMA predicted load
# EXTRACTION QUALITY: clean — values copied exactly as extracted from the PDF text
# VALIDATION: 20 cells checked (AI
# TEXT SOURCE: read from page images by the model (cached transcription)
# ANOMALY FLAG: The failure load is printed three slightly different ways in the report: 134 lb/ft (comparison tables
column5: p. 11); all correspond to the same 2.7 in. H2O failure pressure.

column1: # Load convention: uplift (suction) applied with a pressure box; the reported failure load is the net uniform uplift line load after deducting the 8.5 lb/ft dead load (2.7 in. H2O x 10.4 psf/in. x 5.06 ft tributary width = 142.1 lb/ft; 142.1 - 8.5 = 133.6 lb/ft).
# Tributary width used in the load conversion: 5.06 ft per purlin line.
# Test setup: 3 continuous 30 ft spans
column3: 24 ga. ribbed panels screw-fastened at 1'-0 centers (through-fastened).

column1: # Initial sweep was zero in all members because the discrete braces held the purlins straight.
# Member A-3 did not completely fail but showed a residual buckle in the compression flange lip 14'-7 1/2" from the end support; the bottom flange lip 'tented' about 6" south of the middle brace.
# Longitudinal horizontal movement of the end supports (avg. 0.161 in.) was judged sufficient to relieve catenary forces.
# Yield stress of failed member B-3 from coupon tests: average 55
# SECTION MODULUS NOTE: se_in3 = 2.74 in^3 is the effective (reduced) section modulus at the compression fiber

column5: the farther (compression) fiber; the compression flange is not fully effective at t = 0.0681 in.
column6: Fy = 55 ksi. Calculated value carried as printed
